procedure_source:
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();a=root/'scripts/retire_gmyhf_31381.py';b=root/'scripts/materialize_gmyhf_downloads.py'
original={p:p.read_bytes() for p in (a,b)}
mutants=[
 (a,'目标路由改绑保护',"before.get(NUMBER) in (None, GLOBAL_NUMBER)",'True'),
 (a,'目标额外别名保护',"[n for n, g in before.items() if g == GLOBAL_NUMBER] in ([], [NUMBER])",'True'),
 (a,'其他题目绑定回读',"after == retirement_plan(before)",'True'),
 (a,'课程重复题号保护',"number not in result",'True'),
 (a,'课程ID绑定保护',"row['contestId'] == CONTEST_ID",'True'),
 (a,'默认只读保护',"if not apply:",'if False:'),
 (a,'解绑接口不可改全局删除',"'/api/contest/delete-problem/'","'/api/global-problem/delete/'"),
 (b,'27952固定排除', '27952: "2026-10-24 人拍板：OpenJudge不支持SPJ，本地须另行绑定checker",',''),
 (b,'28341固定排除', '28341: "2026-10-24 人拍板：OpenJudge不支持SPJ，本地须另行绑定checker",',''),
]
results=[]
try:
 for path,label,old,new in mutants:
  source=original[path].decode();assert source.count(old)==1,(label,source.count(old))
  mutated=source.replace(old,new);path.write_text(mutated)
  try:
   proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_spj_retirement'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
   if proc.returncode==0:raise RuntimeError('变异未检出:'+label)
   if 'SyntaxError' in proc.stderr or 'ImportError' in proc.stderr:raise RuntimeError('变异因导入错误失败:'+label)
   results.append({'mutation':label,'detected':True,'exit_code':proc.returncode,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(mutated.encode()).hexdigest()})
   print(label,'已检出',flush=True)
  finally:path.write_bytes(original[path])
finally:
 for p,payload in original.items():p.write_bytes(payload)
report={'results':results,'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for p,v in original.items()},'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'collab/gmyhf-spj-platform-retirement-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
